name: zhihu/web/video-search-v3
description: Returns Zhihu video search results matching a specified keyword. Supports pagination using offset and limit parameters, and accepts a search hash ID.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme: # Zhihu Video Search (V3) API Returns Zhihu search results for a keyword, mostly video entries with title, author, cover image and comment count. The only required input is `keyword`. Results page with `offset` and `limit`. ## Use cases - Find Zhihu videos that mention a brand or product such as OpenAI. - Collect video authors and their follower counts to find creators who cover a topic. - Gather cover images and video stream URLs for videos that match a keyword. - Page through all matches for a keyword to track new Zhihu video content over time. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/video-search-v3" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"keyword": "OpenAI"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `keyword` | string | Yes | Search Keywords | | `limit` | string | No | Number of videos per page | | `offset` | string | No | Offset | | `search_hash_id` | string | No | Search Hash ID | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "ab_params": "sb_cardfilter=1;dm_center_feature=1;dm_hotvideo=0;dm_paid_recency=0;dm_l1_rel=0;…", "data": [ { "highlight": { "creator": "太空就是我", "description": "目前看用低端设备也能跑#openai #chatgpt #人工智能", "title": "聊聊OpenAi" }, "hit_labels": null, "id": "1789796275463544832", "index": 0, "object": { "attached_info_bytes": "related_search_result": [], "search_action_info": { "attached_info_bytes": "OqQBEiAzZTQ5ZDk4NjY4YmQwNzQ0OGQzNDM2NjJlZWI0NDNjNEoGb3BlbmFpUABYFGABagZPcGVuQUlw…", "isfeed": false, "lc_idx": 20, "search_hash_id": "3e49d98668bd07448d343662eeb443c4" } } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[].type` | Kind of result. `zvideo` marks a video entry. `search_result` marks a text post that can embed a video. | | `data[].id` | ID of the result as a string. | | `data[].highlight.title / data[].highlight.description / data[].highlight.creator` | Title, description and creator name with the matched keyword wrapped in `` tags. | | `data[].object.author.follower_count` | Number of followers of the video author. | | `data[].object.author.headline` | Short profile line of the author. | | `data[].object.comment_count` | Number of comments on the item. | | `data[].object.cover_url` | URL of the cover image for the item. | | `data[].object.created_time` | Creation time of a `search_result` item. It looks like a Unix timestamp in seconds. | | `data[].object.content[].playlist[]` | Video files for an embedded video, each with `quality`, `format`, `height`, `bitrate`, `size` and `url`. | | `search_action_info.search_hash_id` | Hash ID for this search. You can pass it back in `search_hash_id` on later requests. | | `paging.is_end` | Tells you whether the last page has been reached. `paging.next` holds the URL for the next page. | ## Notes - Use `offset` and `limit` to move through pages. Check `paging.is_end` to know when to stop. - The response mixes `zvideo` entries with `search_result` entries, so check `data[].type` before you read fields. Fields such as `cover_info` appear on videos, while `content` and `excerpt` appear on text posts. - To search Zhihu articles and answers instead, call [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail): Retrieves detailed information for a specific Zhihu answer using its numeric ID, including answer text, timestamps, and share links. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse…
